His campaign maintained he was home with the flu, and security camera images from his Austin home now back that up. But GOP strategists and journalists are torching the campaign's response as "mind-numbing malpractice" for not releasing the footage sooner.

With Election Day just weeks away in one of the biggest Senate races in the country, the question has shifted from where Talarico was to why his team let the narrative spiral unchecked when they had the receipts the entire time.

Grok Imagine can now generate amazing custom music directly for your videos... and it's incredibly easy to use 🎵

Here's how to add music:

1. Generate your video in Grok Imagine
2. Click the music icon at the top
3. Select “+ Add music”
4. Describe the music you want....mood, tempo, instruments, vocals or no vocals, or simply write your own prompt
5. Click Generate
6. Preview your generated music
7. Select the section that fits your video
8. Click Apply

And the best part is that your generated music is automatically saved to your library, so you can reuse it in future videos too

Video generation and custom soundtracks in the same workflow

Grok Imagine is now an incredibly powerful tool for creators
